name: Stracci Law Group

offices.label: Stracci Law Group - Personal Injury Attorneys Indiana

about: Stracci Law Group works out of one office on Broadway in Crown Point and names seven people on its site, none of them with a stated role, so this profile counts them without calling them attorneys.

The firm offers a free consultation. It publishes no fee terms and no case results, which is most of what pillar B and pillar E measure, and it holds the largest number of Google reviews of any firm in this market.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

_ahrefs_partial_from_cohort.name: Stracci Law Group - Personal Injury Attorneys Indiana

G1.evidence: Indiana does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.source: Published decisions of the Supreme Court of Indiana on the discipline of Indiana attorneys, indexed by CourtListener (Free Law Project)
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names appears as the respondent in any of the 301 published discipline decisions of the Supreme Court of Indiana on the discipline of Indiana attorneys, 1960 to 2026. 1 of them share a surname with a disciplined attorney and were read against the text of those decisions, which name somebody else. Published decisions record what has been decided, so this covers a disbarment or suspension on the record and not whether a registration is current today.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. Indiana publishes no business register we can query. INBiz answers an automated reader with a 403 and the Secretary of State's business search answers with a 202 and an empty body, which is a bot challenge, and we do not work around either. This is a limit of the published record and not something the firm can change.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 7 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 349 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2014-05-01, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP
